messages:
incident-bot: Automatic alert fired -> PagerDuty high severity. Trigger: host-monitor + kernel_panic + kubelet_unready on node srv-gpu-57. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-88776
pagerduty: Incident #PD-88776 created (high): host srv-gpu-57 kernel panic. Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-sre-lead.
Erin Zhao: ack — I'm primary oncall. grabbing logs, will triage. :mag:
Alice Chen: ack from secondary. if it's kernel panic we should cordon then drain, shift traffic, and provision replacement.
Ben Park: paging infra: I'll stand by to reprovision once you confirm.
Carlos Rivera: monitoring: inference-api-us-west 5xx jump to ~4%. frontend errors spike correspond to ~4 client jobs failing. tagging customers: LensAI, AeroML.
incident-bot: PD update: Incident acknowledged by Erin Zhao. Escalation timer paused.
Erin Zhao: initial checks: kubelet on srv-gpu-57 not responding, node shows Ready=False. contacting serial console.
Dana Liu: joining. copying serial console now. early dmesg shows repeated UVM/driver faults, then panic. saving snippet below.
Erin Zhao: plan: 1) cordon & drain 2) reroute 30% traffic to dedicated-reserve in us-west 3) provision replacement host srv-gpu-88 4) retire srv-gpu-57 if hw fault confirmed.
Alice Chen: agreed. I'll run cordon/drain. Ben, start prep for srv-gpu-88 image and NIC config.
Ben Park: prepping image. ETA ~20m. I'll also open a hardware ticket with colo.
Erin Zhao: running: `kubectl cordon srv-gpu-57 && kubectl drain srv-gpu-57 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
deploy-bot: drain job started by Erin Zhao. status: in_progress.
Ben Park: drain logs: node/srv-gpu-57 cordoned
evicting pods... workload-a-123 evicted
workload-b-456 pending termination (grace=30s)

Carlos Rivera: applied temporary route: shifted 30% prod traffic to dedicated-reserve-us-west. watching errors/latency.
Dana Liu: serial console excerpt:
```
[ 4567.891012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:66:00): 43, pid=4342, comm=python "GPU page fault"
[ 4567.891020] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer deref at 0000000000000020
[ 4567.891030] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 4567.891045] Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x6d/0x88
  ? nvidia_uvm_handle_fault+0x1b0/0x260
  panic+0x13c/0x2a0
```
Erin Zhao: saving full logs to S3: s3://redwood-ops/pd-88776/srv-gpu-57/console.log. attaching to PD.
incident-bot: PD update: hardware suspected. Escalating to eng-sre-lead (Dana Liu).
Dana Liu: reading host metrics — GPU thermal and mem look normal before crash, but UVM counters spike. driver version: 535.86.05, kernel: 6.1. pinning notes for postmortem.
Alice Chen: Ben once replacement is ready, add to cluster as srv-gpu-88, run smoke, then uncordon. I'll keep traffic shifted until healthy.
Ben Park: provisioning playbook: `ansible-playbook -i inventory reprovision_gpu.yml --extra-vars "host=srv-gpu-88 image=prod-gpu-2026-02"`
Ben Park: playbook succeeded; kubelet registered: node/srv-gpu-88 Ready=True.
Erin Zhao: running smoke: small inference job passed. readiness probes green.
Ben Park: uncordon: `kubectl uncordon srv-gpu-88`
deploy-bot: uncordon by Ben Park. status: success.
Carlos Rivera: rolling traffic back: reduced dedicated-reserve to normal, overall 5xx down to 0.6% (baseline ~0.5%). customers LensAI and AeroML retried and completed jobs. opening support ticket: SUP-4277 for LensAI, noting transient failures.
Dana Liu: attached crashdump + kernel log to PD and S3: s3://redwood-ops/pd-88776/crashdump.tgz. initial hypothesis: UVM fault triggered by specific workload memory pattern + driver edge case.
Erin Zhao: marking srv-gpu-57 as retired in inventory (lifecycle=decommission). Ben to coordinate hardware replacement with colo.
Ben Park: updated inventory, raised colo ticket #COLO-9901 to replace GPU board.
incident-bot: PD status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Traffic stabilized.
Erin Zhao: notes for post-incident: pin driver to 535.86.05 rollback candidate? or test 525 series. add regression tests simulating UVM heavy allocations. assign postmortem owner.
Alice Chen: assigning postmortem to Dana Liu. Dana, can you run RCA and remediation items?
Dana Liu: will own postmortem. will include timeline, crashdump analysis, recommended driver lock + regression test, and a mitigation runbook for future UVM panics. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Erin Zhao: final: incident handoff to follow-up rotation. I'm off-call. thanks all for quick mitigation. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident #PD-88776 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring).
Carlos Rivera: :thumbsup: good job. closing live thread, follow-up in postmortem doc.
Erin Zhao: leaving a small follow-up checklist in ops-runbooks: `/runbooks/mitigate-gpu-kernel-panic.md` and linking PD and SUP tickets.
Alice Chen: closing coordination thread.
